title: Network Dynamics of Positive and Negative Affect in Bipolar Disorder
sample_size: 32 adults with bipolar I disorder and 36 healthy control participants
n_nodes: 10 (5 positive affect, 5 negative affect) plus actigraphy-derived activity
limitations: - Network analyses assume stationarity; - Affect ratings collected only once per day; - Sample size may be too small for robust network estimation; - No data on gender differences; - No data on neurocognitive or social cognition domains
notes: The paper does not mention preregistration. Code and data availability are not explicitly stated in the main text or supplementary materials. The authors may have made them available but it is not confirmed.
